findings.summary: Legacy bell disconnected; supplied-row read handler reports false success.
findings.impact: Normal shell shows empty independent of provider queue. Nonempty legacy handler does not persist or remove anything.

findings.summary: Normal settings samples claim a real payment/security event without test labeling.
findings.impact: Payment received and privileged action queued for review are synthetic local calls with business-looking source types. Development-only demo guard does not cover these controls.

findings.summary: DEFERRED messages are excluded from all communication claimers and no controlled requeue path was found.
findings.impact: Providing missing provider configuration alone does not resume previously deferred messages. No production recovery was executed.
findings.remediation: Current guarded statement retry, revision/command replay, mandatory audit, real PostgreSQL concurrency/rollback and EN/FR lost-response recovery verified. Unknown and other worker outcomes remain open.

findings.summary: External acceptance before durable completion can cause duplicate sends on retry.
findings.impact: Statement email lacks provider idempotency identity; WhatsApp adapters expose none. Five-minute lease reclaim plus no heartbeat or request timeout can overlap slow sends. Accountant email does supply an Idempotency-Key; provider retention guarantees remain unverified.
findings.remediation: Durable statement dispatch reservation, generation fence and conservative unknown-outcome hold passed real PostgreSQL failure/concurrency checks. Other adapters and live provider behavior remain open.

findings.summary: WhatsApp receipt worker does not reapply current fiscal-delivery blocking state.
findings.impact: Initial queue checks certification, but a changed blocked certification between queue and worker is absent from fingerprint and worker decision. Focused test required; no send attempted.

findings.summary: Statement/invite validation exceptions update transport status without corresponding domain delivery state.
findings.impact: Invalid/expired evidence may leave domain status QUEUED while outbox is FAILED/DEAD_LETTER; verify intended read-model precedence and append failure evidence.
findings.remediation: Statement validation/provider outcomes now append domain and transport evidence atomically. Accountant delivery remains open.

findings.summary: Customer statement UI creates fresh command identity and consent timestamp on every retry.
findings.impact: If queue committed but response is lost, user retry produces another valid delivery/token/outbox rather than replaying the same request. Share with CS lane.

findings.summary: Signal digest helper uses immediate-notification suppression and ignores configured timezone.
findings.impact: digestOnly removes noncritical signals even when building a digest; quietHours uses UTC despite timezone field. Digest output org/user are not compared with preference identity. No production caller found; not a demonstrated leak.

findings.summary: Session notification queue lacks actor/tenant binding and reset.
findings.impact: Provider remains global with business labels/amounts in local memory; actor or tenant switch lifetime must be tested before claiming isolation.

findings.summary: Shared transient notifications lack a live-region role and contain English-only controls.
findings.impact: No role/status/aria-live found in notification tree; New, High priority, Dismiss and convenience strings remain English. Actual assistive-technology and EN/FR behavior not tested.

findings.summary: Reconciliation notification view has no acknowledgement or preference persistence.
findings.impact: Every publication upserts UNREAD; repeated dashboard loads increment attempts and refresh processedAt. UI shows only eight without acknowledgement; domain read triggers writes. This may be intentional shared alert behavior but must not be presented as a completed user inbox.

findings.summary: Narrow/enlarged-text review overflow and a hover state stranded after the read button disappears.
findings.impact: Reading controls clipped or notices remained indefinitely. Container-based layout and hover reconciliation correct these paths.

findings.summary: Stored non-booleans entered sound state and mount temporarily overwrote an existing disabled preference.
findings.impact: Only explicit toggles now write; invalid values use a boolean default, failed saves are visible and other tabs synchronize.

findings.summary: Local read and read-all overwrote an explicitly external delivery failure with read.
findings.impact: Local acknowledgement now preserves the external delivery state. No recipient-read or delivery evidence is manufactured.
